operations.inserted: { id: "sheet.table.autoFilter.criteria.read/v1", version: 1, kind: "READ", format: "XLSX", mutation: "NO", semanticContract: "one Excel Table (sheet name + table DisplayName): whether it carries its own AutoFilter (present, from the SAME internal TablePart.AutoFilter object sheet.tables.read/v1 already reads truthily); if present, its stored range (Ref, same grounded-by-analogy hypothesis sheet.tables.read/v1 already uses for a TablePart's own range) and, per column, a fields array -- each entry a measured colId plus EITHER values (an array of selected value-filter keys) OR custom (and, conditions -- each condition an operator as a raw code, an operatorName ONLY when a runtime enum resolves it else null, and a value); a column of a kind never observed (color/dynamic/top10 filter) or whose observed-but-unverified sub-fields are non-default (Dates non-empty, Blank truthy, And:true) carries a named unverified array on that column instead of a guessed meaning. present:false = no AutoFilter on the table; range:null + reason:internal-shape-unverified:ref = the Ref hypothesis failed. GH #361 route probe, route (c); measured against a real, OOXML-preseeded fixture with a table-owned AutoFilter (one value filter, one custom filter)." },

{ id: "sheet.cells.compiledStyle.read/v1", version: 1, kind: "READ", format: "XLSX", mutation: "NO", semanticContract: "a named list of cells (sheet name + up to 200 A1 addresses): each cell's conditional-format-EVALUATED fill colour, read through the worksheet's own getCompiledStyle(row, col) getter (0-based, derived from the A1 address) -- ONLY the fill is read (style.getFill() -> getColor() or getSolidFill()); every other compiled-style field (font, border, number format, ...) is NOT attempted. A cell whose compiled style is null (the engine never produced one -- e.g. no rule evaluates to anything on it) reads compiled:null, never a guessed fill; a cell whose own address does not parse, or whose own read throws, carries its own named reason. GH #363 2nd unit, LIVE measured (docs/GH363-CF-EFFECTIVE-READBACK-MEASUREMENT-20261105.md): a firing cell's compiled fill equals the rule's own fill; a non-firing cell's compiled style is null." },

v : null; } catch (e) { return null; } }   if (typeof c.rgb === "number") return c.rgb;   return null; } function eoCompiledStyleFillOfStyle(style) {   if (!style || typeof style.getFill !== "function") return null;   var fillObj; try { fillObj = style.getFill(); } catch (e) { return null; }   if (!fillObj) return null;   if (typeof fillObj.getColor === "function") {     var c1; try { c1 = fillObj.getColor(); } catch (e) { c1 = null; }     var v1 = eoCompiledStyleColourOf(c1);     if (typeof v1 === "number") return v1;   }   if (typeof fillObj.getSolidFill === "function") {     var c2; try { c2 = fillObj.getSolidFill(); } catch (e) { c2 = null; }     var v2 = eoCompiledStyleColourOf(c2);     if (typeof v2 === "number") return v2;   }   return null; } var out = []; for (var i = 0; i < args.cells.length; i += 1) {   var a1 = args.cells[i];   if (typeof a1 !== "string") { out.push({ cell: a1, compiled: null, reason: "bad-cell-address" }); continue; }   var rc = eoCompiledStyleA1ToRowCol(a1);   if (!rc) { out.push({ cell: a1, compiled: null, reason: "bad-cell-address" }); continue; }   var style; try { style = m.getCompiledStyle(rc.row, rc.col); } catch (e) { out.push({ cell: a1, compiled: null, reason: "threw" }); continue; }   if (!style) { out.push({ cell: a1, compiled: null }); continue; }   out.push({ cell: a1, compiled: { fill: eoCompiledStyleFillOfStyle(style) } }); } return { ok: true, value: out }; },
